\caption{Main results per dataset and configuration on the evaluation segment. ROC-AUC of the fused detector is the pre-specified primary metric; the dispersion column gives the observed range over the two seeds, and says \emph{single run} for the deterministic cells. $F_1$ is calibrated with the label-free P99 rule on the calibration window (never with evaluation labels), and WindowDiff uses the standard boundary definition with the per-stream $k$ given in parentheses. Each dataset block starts with its trivial references: prevalence $p$, $F_{1,\mathrm{trivial}}=2p/(1+p)$ and the row-index baseline AUC$_t$, which models have to beat as $\max($AUC$_t$, 1 $-$ AUC$_t)$ since a detector returning the decreasing index is equally free; $\ddagger$ marks a cell whose mean calibrated $F_1$, the value printed in the same row, is at or below $F_{1,\mathrm{trivial}}$. The analysis plan also tracks a wider indicator, $F_1 \leq F_{1,\mathrm{trivial}} + 0.02$, which holds in at least one seed of 49 of the 99 cells. Chance-level ROC-AUC is 0.5.}\label{tab:main-results}\\
